verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents Glama's pricing per tool call or per connection, and nothing documents rate limits. The only pricing-page item describes workflow automation features, not prices. A community report says credits and a credit card were needed for rebuilds without this being documented, which points away from pricing transparency rather than toward it.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see transparent pricing per tool call or connection plus documented rate limits before committing to the platform
